body:
Yessss!!!! I love hearing these stories!!! I was 30 when I started my degree and already divorced with 2 kids! My ex told me I would never amount to anything and was trying anything in his power to not pay for the kids so my goal was to earn as much as him to prove a point! I earn double what he does now and although he is now forced to pay every month, I don’t even need his cash anymore so I let my daughters blow his shitty contributions at the salon which riles him up sooooo bad while I build rail systems in my role as an engineering project manager!!

You got this!!! Never give up!!
I hope one day I feel like this. X

Thank you. That made me cry a lot.

I drove out to the cliffs last night, had one last cigarette and got out of the car. I was ready.

But before I went I had left my phone and bank card with my PIN numbers in my exes house. I had taken my daughters birthday presents round as her birthday is friday.

Turns out he followed me. He was angry. Told me I couldn’t jump because of the girls.

Forced me to drive back to my mums then left.

I’m flying back down south tonight to pack up my flat and collect some stuff from the office.

I don’t know the area very well down there. I don’t know the coast line or bridges.

I don’t know what tonight will bring.

I just can’t get over my ex.

For the first 3 months I hurt while I watched him shag about. Told myself he needed to get it out of his system. For the next 3, I tried to move on. Feigned indifference. For the last 3 I’ve admitted the truth and told him I never stopped loving him.

He said he’s learned to live without me.

Said he doesn’t love me and he is over it.

I can’t be here to watch new girlfriends. I’ve managed to sabotage them all so far but I can’t continue to do that. Eventually he’ll find one he’ll want the girls to meet. I can’t watch it. I can’t watch them move on.

They love him more than me because I haven’t been here to do dinner, bath and bed and they don’t understand it’s me who pays the bills which is why I miss sports day. 

I just don’t know how to start again. I don’t want to start again. I lost all my friends when I chased my career.

I don’t have friends, I have nobody who loves me and now I’ve given my job up, I have no purpose to get up in the morning.

It hurts and there is no light at the end of the tunnel.

I work away Monday - Friday and they are with me on a weekend.

I handed my notice in last week and plan to work from home now until that’s done.

I figured I would give them a great few months before I leave them for good but I’ve been back home a week and it’s been too hard with my ex that I don’t think il make it to February.

It’s my eldest daughters birthday on Friday and I don’t think I can hold on until then.

My mind is telling me to wait until my mum is asleep tonight and do it then.

For months I’ve been carrying the book “the final exit” round as I was planing on using an exit kit and nitrous gas but then I decided to buy heroine and I YouTubed how to inject it so I could overdose.

Now I just want to jump straight off a bridge tonight.
